name.description: Descriptive name for the banner (e.g., 'Homepage Hero Banner')

banner_type.description: Type of banner - 'image' for simple image or 'hero' for rich hero element

image_url.description: URL of the uploaded banner image (for image type)

alt_text.description: Alternative text for the image (for accessibility)

size.description: Banner width: full (100%), half (50%), or quarter (25%)

position.description: Vertical positioning of the image within the banner

horizontal_alignment.description: Horizontal alignment for half/quarter width banners

page_position.description: Where the banner appears on the page: at the top or below the first dynamic element

hero_content.description: Hero element configuration (for hero type banners)

associated_pages.description: List of public page names where this banner should appear

display_order.description: Order priority if multiple banners on same page (lower numbers show first)

is_active.description: Whether this banner is currently active
